stagingWorksAfterFixes.plain: Staging login, upload, signed-URL view/download, and tenant-scoped reads work after the security fixes. One Critical (C4) had regressed and was re-closed during this audit.

documentUploadView.plain: Authorized fleet manager can upload to their uid folder, save metadata, mint a signed URL, and download the file. Your existing test document remains visible in metadata (68 rows counted; no customer file bytes were opened).

documentsProtectedFromUnauthorized.plain: Anonymous cannot list or download. Direct public URL returns 400. Company B cannot download company A file. After logout a new signed URL cannot be minted. An already-issued signed URL stays valid until the 15-minute TTL (by design, not unlimited).

companyIsolation.plain: Fleet manager A saw zero other-company rows across 54 company_name tables. A could not update or delete B's vehicle. A could not list B's document_metadata.

allCriticalClosed.plain: C1 storage private, C2 signup role, C3 profile lock, C4/C5 token scope, C7 password tenant, C8 phone/login challenge are closed on Staging. C4 was found open mid-audit (anon listed declaration ids) and the two USING(true) policies were dropped again; re-test passed. C6 is a secret-handling item, not a live data-access hole, and remains Owner-gated.

items: FM can Storage-list shared prefixes admin-uploads / request-uploads / exchanges / qa-samples / qa-security across tenants (confirmed: filename of another company's probe was visible).
